verdict.rationale: HubSpot's platform APIs support batch operations (custom objects can be retrieved/updated in batches, bulk import for multiple objects, workflows to automate processes at scale) and the MCP server gives AI agents read/write CRM access, implying bulk actions are technically reachable. However, no evidence explicitly confirms the MCP server or AI agent tools expose batch/bulk endpoints (as opposed to single-record CRUD), so the AI-native bulk-operation pathway is only inferred, not directly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the MCP server or Breeze AI agents can invoke batch/bulk CRM operations (not just single-object create/update), and independent confirmation of bulk performance/reliability at scale.
